newsitem.title: USA: Hunter Aircraft names Townes president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Hunter Aircraft names Townes president/COO.

text.p: Hunter Aircraft Corp said Monday it has appointed Stephen Townes as president, chief operating officer and director of the company.
Townes was previously a divisional president and vice chairman at a St. Louis-based aerospace company.
Townes succeeds Barry Meuse as presdident and chief operating officer, said the company. Meuse remains with the company as chairman and chief executive officer.
Hunter Aircraft Corp is an aerospace services and specialty aircraft development/manufacturing company seeking sotck-leveraged acquisitions for new growth.
